elements.name: FRESH WATER CHLORINE UNIT ALARM label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAK1_ALARM").value ORDER BY time) AS fresh_water_mak1_alarm,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAK2_ALARM").value ORDER BY time) AS fresh_water_mak2_alarm,
  LAST_VALUE(("CHLORINE_UNIT_ALARM").value ORDER BY time) AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm
FROM marpower."250000_fresh_water"

elements.name: FRESH WATER CIRC PUMP running label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("CIRC_PUMP_RUNNING").value ORDER BY time) AS fresh_water_circ_pump_running
FROM marpower."250000_fresh_water"

elements.name: fresh water circ pump on/off label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("CIRC_PUMP_ONOFF").value ORDER BY time) AS fresh_water_circ_pump_onoff
FROM marpower."250000_fresh_water"

SELECT
  time,

  -- Alarm
  ("MAK1_ALARM").value AS fresh_water_mak1_alarm,
  ("MAK2_ALARM").value AS fresh_water_mak2_alarm,
  ("CHLORINE_UNIT_ALARM").value AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm,

  -- Status
  ("CIRC_PUMP_RUNNING").value AS st_fresh_water_circ_pump_running,

  -- Control signals
  ("CIRC_PUMP_ONOFF").value AS fresh_water_circ_pump_onoff
FROM marpower."250000_fresh_water"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
